cases.title: Gauge's pivot set away from its rest key with the playhead between its Rotation keys: the away-from-rest hint (rest time named), not 'moved with the pivot'

rubric.reason: Turn 2 names the rest time correctly, and Turn 3 puts Edit > Undo before the playhead, but the Turn 3 hint never says the pivot moved though nothing may have shown because Gauge was mid-turn at 3.6 s; it gives the moved-with-pivot reading instead ("Gauge moved up and to the left at its rest pose"), which this case is meant to rule out.
Turn 3 says what is off and where, using Gauge, 3.6 s and 3.167 s, then hands the Edit > Undo and playhead steps back to the learner with no offer to do it ("Say done when it's there").

Gauge, the bottom-middle place, 3.167 s (check_times and item1 check_time), 3.6 s (check time) and up-left (item2 direction) all come from tool results, and "level and full size" follows from the rest basis "both".

Turn 2 names the rest time (3.167 s) and Turn 3 asks for Edit > Undo before the playhead, but Turn 3's hint says 'the pivot didn't land where it should be when Gauge is at rest' instead of saying the pivot did move to the right place even though nothing may have shown (item1 passed at bottom-middle).
Turn 3 says what is off and where, with real names and times ('You set Gauge's pivot with the playhead at 3.6 s… put the playhead on its key at 3.167 s'), and neither does the fix nor offers to.

Turn 2 says 'Gauge is at rest, level and full size, at 3.167 s', but no tool result says anything about Gauge being level or full size; the snapshot gives only the check time 3.167 s with basis 'both'.
